$$
\iint_S\operatorname{curl}F\cdot\mathrm{d}S.
$$

$$
{∮}_{C}F\cdot dr={∬}_{S}\text{curl}\,F\cdot \text{d}S.
$$

Along the curve $C,$ we have

$$
x=\cos{\left(t \right)},\quad y=- 3 \sin{\left(t \right)},\quad z=1
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}F(r(t)) & =\langle - 2 y, 2 x, 0\rangle \\ & =\langle - 2 \left(- 3 \sin{\left(t \right)}\right), 2 \left(\cos{\left(t \right)}\right), 0\rangle \\ & =\langle 6 \sin{\left(t \right)}, 2 \cos{\left(t \right)}, 0\rangle\end{aligned}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}r\prime(t) & =\langle \frac{\mathrm d}{\mathrm dt}\left(\cos{\left(t \right)}\right), \frac{\mathrm d}{\mathrm dt}\left(- 3 \sin{\left(t \right)}\right), \frac{\mathrm d}{\mathrm dt}\left(1\right)\rangle \\ & =\langle - \sin{\left(t \right)}, - 3 \cos{\left(t \right)}, 0\rangle\end{aligned}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}F(r(t))\cdot r\prime(t) & =\langle 6 \sin{\left(t \right)}, 2 \cos{\left(t \right)}, 0\rangle\cdot \langle - \sin{\left(t \right)}, - 3 \cos{\left(t \right)}, 0\rangle \\ & =\left(6 \sin{\left(t \right)}\right)\cdot \left(- \sin{\left(t \right)}\right)+\left(2 \cos{\left(t \right)}\right)\cdot \left(- 3 \cos{\left(t \right)}\right)+\left(0\right)\cdot \left(0\right) \\ & =\left(- 6 \sin^{2}{\left(t \right)}\right)+\left(- 6 \cos^{2}{\left(t \right)}\right)+\left(0\right) \\ & =- 6 \sin^{2}{\left(t \right)} - 6 \cos^{2}{\left(t \right)} \\ & =-6\end{aligned}

$$
\iint_S\operatorname{curl}F\cdot\mathrm{d}S.
$$
question.:question/worked-solution:
Let $S$ be an oriented piecewise-smooth surface bounded by a simple, closed, piecewise-smooth boundary $C$ with positive orientation. If a vector field $F$ has continuous partial derivatives for all its components in an open region in space that contains $S,$ then Stokes' theorem states that

$$
{∮}_{C}F\cdot dr={∬}_{S}\text{curl}\,F\cdot \text{d}S.
$$

Along the curve $C,$ we have

$$
x=\cos{\left(\pi t \right)},\quad y=\sin{\left(\pi t \right)},\quad z=2 \sin{\left(\pi t \right)}
$$

So,

$$
\begin{aligned}F(r(t)) & =\langle 2 y, - 2 x, e^{- 2 y + z}\rangle \\ & =\langle 2 \left(\sin{\left(\pi t \right)}\right), - 2 \left(\cos{\left(\pi t \right)}\right), e^{- 2 \left(\sin{\left(\pi t \right)}\right) + \left(2 \sin{\left(\pi t \right)}\right)}\rangle \\ & =\langle 2 \sin{\left(\pi t \right)}, - 2 \cos{\left(\pi t \right)}, 1\rangle\end{aligned}
$$

Computing $r\prime(t),$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}r\prime(t) & =\langle \frac{\mathrm d}{\mathrm dt}\left(\cos{\left(\pi t \right)}\right), \frac{\mathrm d}{\mathrm dt}\left(\sin{\left(\pi t \right)}\right), \frac{\mathrm d}{\mathrm dt}\left(2 \sin{\left(\pi t \right)}\right)\rangle \\ & =\langle - \pi \sin{\left(\pi t \right)}, \pi \cos{\left(\pi t \right)}, 2 \pi \cos{\left(\pi t \right)}\rangle\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}F(r(t))\cdot r\prime(t) & =\langle 2 \sin{\left(\pi t \right)}, - 2 \cos{\left(\pi t \right)}, 1\rangle\cdot \langle - \pi \sin{\left(\pi t \right)}, \pi \cos{\left(\pi t \right)}, 2 \pi \cos{\left(\pi t \right)}\rangle \\ & =\left(2 \sin{\left(\pi t \right)}\right)\cdot \left(- \pi \sin{\left(\pi t \right)}\right)+\left(- 2 \cos{\left(\pi t \right)}\right)\cdot \left(\pi \cos{\left(\pi t \right)}\right)+\left(1\right)\cdot \left(2 \pi \cos{\left(\pi t \right)}\right) \\ & =\left(- 2 \pi \sin^{2}{\left(\pi t \right)}\right)+\left(- 2 \pi \cos^{2}{\left(\pi t \right)}\right)+\left(2 \pi \cos{\left(\pi t \right)}\right) \\ & =- 2 \pi \sin^{2}{\left(\pi t \right)} - 2 \pi \cos^{2}{\left(\pi t \right)} + 2 \pi \cos{\left(\pi t \right)} \\ & =2 \pi \cos{\left(\pi t \right)} - 2 \pi\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we evaluate the integral as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\iint_S\operatorname{curl}F\cdot\mathrm dS & =\oint_C F\cdot\mathrm dr \\ & =\int_{-1}^{1} F(r(t))\cdot r\prime(t)\,\mathrm dt \\ & =\int_{-1}^{1}\left(2 \pi \cos{\left(\pi t \right)} - 2 \pi\right)\,\mathrm dt \\ & =\left[\left(- 2 \pi t\right) + \left(2 \sin{\left(\pi t \right)}\right)\right]_{-1}^{1} \\ & =\left(\left(- 2 \pi\right) + \left(0\right)\right)-\left(\left(2 \pi\right) + \left(0\right)\right) \\ & =- 4 \pi\end{aligned}
$$

$$
x=\cos{\left(t \right)},\quad y=- \sin{\left(t \right)},\quad z=\sin{\left(t \right)} - 1
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}F(r(t)) & =\langle - y + z, x - z, - x + y\rangle \\ & =\langle - \left(- \sin{\left(t \right)}\right) + \left(\sin{\left(t \right)} - 1\right), \left(\cos{\left(t \right)}\right) - \left(\sin{\left(t \right)} - 1\right), - \left(\cos{\left(t \right)}\right) + \left(- \sin{\left(t \right)}\right)\rangle \\ & =\langle 2 \sin{\left(t \right)} - 1, - \sin{\left(t \right)} + \cos{\left(t \right)} + 1, - \sin{\left(t \right)} - \cos{\left(t \right)}\rangle\end{aligned}
$$

Computing $r\prime(t),$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}r\prime(t) & =\langle \frac{\mathrm d}{\mathrm dt}\left(\cos{\left(t \right)}\right), \frac{\mathrm d}{\mathrm dt}\left(- \sin{\left(t \right)}\right), \frac{\mathrm d}{\mathrm dt}\left(\sin{\left(t \right)} - 1\right)\rangle \\ & =\langle - \sin{\left(t \right)}, - \cos{\left(t \right)}, \cos{\left(t \right)}\rangle\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}F(r(t))\cdot r\prime(t) & =\langle 2 \sin{\left(t \right)} - 1, - \sin{\left(t \right)} + \cos{\left(t \right)} + 1, - \sin{\left(t \right)} - \cos{\left(t \right)}\rangle\cdot \langle - \sin{\left(t \right)}, - \cos{\left(t \right)}, \cos{\left(t \right)}\rangle \\ & =\left(2 \sin{\left(t \right)} - 1\right)\cdot \left(- \sin{\left(t \right)}\right)+\left(- \sin{\left(t \right)} + \cos{\left(t \right)} + 1\right)\cdot \left(- \cos{\left(t \right)}\right)+\left(- \sin{\left(t \right)} - \cos{\left(t \right)}\right)\cdot \left(\cos{\left(t \right)}\right) \\ & =\left(- 2 \sin^{2}{\left(t \right)} + \sin{\left(t \right)}\right)+\left(\sin{\left(t \right)} \cos{\left(t \right)} - \cos^{2}{\left(t \right)} - \cos{\left(t \right)}\right)+\left(- \sin{\left(t \right)} \cos{\left(t \right)} - \cos^{2}{\left(t \right)}\right) \\ & =- 2 \sin^{2}{\left(t \right)} + \sin{\left(t \right)} - 2 \cos^{2}{\left(t \right)} - \cos{\left(t \right)} \\ & =\sin{\left(t \right)} - \cos{\left(t \right)} - 2\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we evaluate the integral as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\iint_S\operatorname{curl}F\cdot\mathrm dS & =\oint_C F\cdot\mathrm dr \\ & =\int_{0}^{2 \pi} F(r(t))\cdot r\prime(t)\,\mathrm dt \\ & =\int_{0}^{2 \pi}\left(\sin{\left(t \right)} - \cos{\left(t \right)} - 2\right)\,\mathrm dt \\ & =\left[\left(- 2 t\right) + \left(- \sin{\left(t \right)}\right) + \left(- \cos{\left(t \right)}\right)\right]_{0}^{2 \pi} \\ & =\left(\left(- 4 \pi\right) + \left(0\right) + \left(-1\right)\right)-\left(\left(0\right) + \left(0\right) + \left(-1\right)\right) \\ & =- 4 \pi\end{aligned}
